mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 140,000 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,000, robust consumer demand and labor market strength drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000 and HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a 3-month acceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals sustained demand momentum that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 growth accelerates.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates strong manufacturing output, correlating with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0, persistent inflationary pressure triggers central bank rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 140,000 and unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, a tight labor market boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000 and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 440,000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,000 units, strong consumer and housing demand support corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 440000 and HOUST > 1000.
